$comment: Golden conversation for the HelloCamera phone-client conformance kit. Meta-format: docs/conformance/README.md.
title: Complete snapshots atomically replace every lane with strictly increasing revisions
summary: After acceptance the desktop sends a complete coaching_state_v2 whenever the visible projection changes. Every lane is required; the phone atomically replaces all lanes only when the object passes schema and semantic validation, sessionId matches the accepted connection session, and stateRevision is greater than the last applied revision. needs_intention -> orienting -> coaching shows atomic replacement across phases.

steps.note: Establishes the accepted sessionId used by every later snapshot. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.2)

activity.text: What would you like to photograph?

steps.note: needs_intention: task/intention null, instruction null, required waiting Activity, no overlays/actions/visual. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §6.1)

message.acceptedIntention: A confident full-body portrait at sunset

steps.note: orienting: task/intention non-null, instruction null, required working/waiting Activity. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §6.1)

message.acceptedIntention: A confident full-body portrait at sunset

instruction.text: Photographer: move one step to your left.

steps.note: coaching: actionable current Instruction; Activity nullable; actions target the current instruction/task. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §6.1, §7)

outcome: Each snapshot atomically replaces all lanes. The phone applies only matching-session, strictly-increasing-revision, schema-and-semantically valid snapshots. The last valid projection and revision are retained on any failure.
